summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness network-proxy plugin: route the agent's own network requests (web_search / web_fetch / external APIs) through a configured HTTP/HTTPS-CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy, persisted and auto-applied at startup, with a settings UI.
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness network-proxy plugin: route the agent's own network requests (web_search / web_fetch / external APIs) through a configured HTTP/HTTPS-CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy, persisted and auto-applied at startup, with a settings UI.
